filter_aspect_ratio_anomaly.name: filter_aspect_ratio_anomaly
filter_aspect_ratio_anomaly.description: Filters bounding boxes that deviate from typical human aspect ratios (0.3 to 0.7) to suppress reflections.
filter_aspect_ratio_anomaly.code:
def filter_aspect_ratio_anomaly(box):
    w = box.get('x2', 0) - box.get('x1', 0)
    h = box.get('y2', 0) - box.get('y1', 0)
    if h <= 0: return False
    aspect = w / h
    return 0.2 <= aspect <= 0.85
